summary: Describes an optimized ingress replication solution for EVPN-based network virtualization overlays. Ingress replication avoids needing PIM in the network core but can send multiple copies of the same packet over one link; this solution reduces that cost while still not depending on PIM.

eli5.summary: Sending a flyer to many houses by posting separate copies down the same street is wasteful. This reduces the wasted copies without needing special equipment.
